batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b P Awana

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c KB Arun Karthik b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b R Rampaul

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c MC Henriques b M Kartik

balls.text: full toss. That's 62 off four Nesser overs. Misses Dinda's IPL record by one. This has been lofted over cover for four. It was actually asking for the six and thus the record
yorker, middle and leg, dug out for one
short, wide, not too high, and AB murders it. Cut in front of square for a six over cover. Incredible batting
AB, how do you bowl to him? He inverts his stance, and sweeps this length ball fine of short third man
low full toss, driven to long-on, where Sathish makes a rare misfield. It just spun away at the last moment
full and wide, driven away to cover
misses the yorker again. By a few inches, and Henriques drives this to the left of the diving mid-off for four more
this time Henriques doesn't back away, PK bowls straight, misses the yorker, bowls a juicy full toss, and has been despatched over midwicket
and again Henriques backs away and he goes wide away again. Can't reach it again
well bowled again. Full and wide as he sees Henriques backing away. Can't reach it
wide yorker again, and he has backed away too far, and gets just the single
yorker, middle and leg, dug out for one
slower ball, short of a length, worked into the leg side for one
looks for the reverse paddle again, and again the ball is a little slow, and ends up playing it to point for one
wide half-volley, AB goes hard at it, and gets a thick edge over short third man. This might have been edged, but this was a poor delivery. A wide half-volley with the third man up
de Villiers tries the reverse paddle this time to a full ball on off. Edges it back to the bowler
slower short ball, wide too, AB has swatted this mercilessly over midwicket for six
full, outside off, dug out
full toss, on off, driven to long-off. A good over despite that wide

that's a good ball. Dug in short, catches Kohli on the front foot, and it is between the chest and shoulder, which is a good height for a man on the front foot. Kohli goes ahead with the pull, Marsh runs back from midwicket and takes this over his shoulder
full, goes across the line to drag this to midwicket for one
another yorker, on middle, Kohli gets just the single to midwicket
follows the batsman again, but this time it is a yorker, and AB can't get back inside the line
wide down the leg side. Trying to counter as AB moves away, but the batsman gets inside the line
short, into the body, AB pulls it powerfully, but finds the man at midwicket
down the wicket, and it doesn't matter the ball is short. AB drives it over the bowler's head, but Sathish does really well to run around from long-on to keep them down to one
short of a length, straight, worked away for one
AB moves across the stumps to push this length ball to long-on for one
outswinger. Pitched up fuller, outside off, beats the outside edge
not the most desired way to get it, but he gets four first up. Pushes at a wide length ball, edges it past the keeper for four
Gony gets another. Pujara charges at him and swipes across the line, dragging this wide length ball onto his stumps
driven to long-on for another single
low full toss, on the pads, driven to long-on

superb work from PK. A lovely yorker, dug out back on the pitch, Pujara calls him through for one. PK runs straight down the pitch, has to change his direction three times because Kohli is running at him too. Finally he gets there and flicks this onto the stumps. Pujara's bat is on the line as the bail comes off. He has not been given. That's strange. And they have taken the overthrow too. This was out. The bail was completely off with his bat just on the line. Perhaps the umpire thought only one end of the bail was off
another wide down the leg side
yorker gone wrong. Wide down the leg side
down the wicket and makes room, Praveen follows him with a yorker, goes for a leg-bye
short of a length, middle and leg, pulled away to deep midwicket
driven on the up, gets a single to deep cover
slower ball, shortish, punched to extra cover, takes the single that takes him to fifty
short of a length, outside off, pushed with an open face
short of a length, outside off, opens the face, gets a single
short, into the body, pulled powerfully down the ground, to the left of midwicket. Along the ground again
short of a length, down the wicket, drives on the up, between mid-off and cover. All along the ground
short, outside off, cut away to the left of deep point
quicker, toppie, hits the top half of the defensive bat
short, wide, Kohli beaten on the cut
googly, middle and off, whipped away to deep midwicket
full, outside off, swept away nicely, all along the ground, between square leg sand midwicket
Chawla is back to being a spinner again. Tossed up outside off, he kicks this away
bouncer, on off, he ducks under it
short of a length, nicely played. He stands tall, opens the face late, and beats third man to his left
driven on the up, gets a single to deep point
gets this one to shape away, takes the edge, but it goes to third man for one
Gony comes back. Gayle plays across the line for a change. Gony has bowled straight and short of a length. Gayle misses, and the top of the middle stump is hit. Euphoria all around
full, on the pads, Gayle has nonchalantly flicked it over long-on for a huge six
worked into the on side for one
122.4ks. Is this the quickest a spinner has ever bowled without chucking? Gayle manages an inside edge into the pad
seam up. At 118ks. Don't rub your eyes. He has put a lot of shoulder into this. Gayle drives this towards long-off, wide of it
tossed up on middle and off, turning towards off, bunted into the leg side for one
slightly short of a length, pushed to cover
flat, on off, looks to late-cut it, gets an edge for four
full, on off, dug out to deep midwicket for two
beamer. On the pads. Worked away for two to bring up his fifty
clipped away to fine leg for one
good bouncer. At 140ks, gets it above the shoulder. Might even have kissed the helmet on its way. Pujara is late into the hook
full and outside leg, Gayle makes room, gets an inside edge for one

top edge. Four. That's cruel. Neser goes short again, but rolls his fingers on it. And it is an offcutter even though it is moving away from Gayle. He backs away and swings, and edges it over the keeper
digs this one in short, and gets appreciable bounce. Defended in front of the chest
Chawla bowls another dart, and gets away with just the leg-bye. A good over
flat, on the pads, worked away for one. PK misfields at short fine leg. Concedes the second
tries the paddle to get off strike, but gets a leg-bye, which does the job actually
googly. Flat too. On a length, just outside off, Pujara ends up defending again
Pujara jumps at it, Chawla pushes this through, Pujara is beaten in the flight, and ends up kicking at it
nearly a return catch. Pujara is early into the push, and it falls just short
into the pads, on a length, but he misses out on it, and gets just the one leg-bye
short ball, looks to ramp this, but is beaten by the extra bounce
slower ball, outside off, punched to the right of deep point for two
short of a length, outside off, punched away, but not past point
full, angling in, Pujara drags this to wide of long-on for two
short, wide, gets away with it as this is hit straight to deep point
short of a length, pitched outside leg, pushed away for one
another dart. Wide down the leg side this time
another dart. Too short. Punched through straight cover. There is a long-off in place, but he cannot get around
short of a length, turning in, punched down to hand over the strike again
dart. And absolute dart. Into the pads. Goes for a leg-bye
short of a length, middle and leg, punched down the ground for one
on a length, on middle and leg, defended to midwicket
a mis-hit goes into the boundary on the bounce. This has skidded on Gayle, and he is late into his loft. However, the mis-hit clears mid-on with ease, and nearly carries all the way
dabs this to point for one
lovely shot. Short of a length, just outside off, he stands tall, and punches this fine of point and to the right of third man. Nothing wrong with the ball
full, on the pads, easy hit for Pujara. Over midwicket it goes
Pujara hits hard at a wide length ball, and edges it fine of third man for four
short of a length, into the ribs, the extra bounce again. Hit in the ribs
we've been expecting you, Mr Neser. Now can you get that ball on your back please? On a length, middle and leg, swung out of sight by Gayle. over midwicket again

this is actually a good bouncer, but Gayle has done well with this. Perhaps the pace helped him. Neser got it high, and outside leg, but Gayle has time to back away and pull it over deep midwicket. That was head high
half-volley, on off, driven to mid-on for one
gets under a length ball this time. Shimmied down the track too. Over cover it goes
on a length, on off, Pujara tries the big hit, is hit on the inside half of the bat
on a length, on off, defended towards mid-off
gets extra bounce from this shortish delivery. Beats his attempt to punch at it
another back-foot drive, another stop at point
short of a length, Pujara is on his toes to punch this, but Miller makes a diving save at point
backs away to pull this shortish delivery, doesn't get all of it. Fielded at square leg
bouncer, 133ks, Gayle stands tall and pulls it to the right of deep midwicket. Flat hit. Not much behind this bouncer
short of a length, on off, defended from the crease
pushed towards mid-on. Mandeep charges in to deny the single, but he runs past it, and allows them the second
short of a length, outside off, holds its line a touch, defended with an open face
short of a length, outside off, moving away, beats the cut
short of a length, outside leg, Gayle misses, but takes a leg-bye
another big inswinger, beats the outside edge, hits him on the back pad, but is swinging away to miss off
pushed away for four. That's no more than a push. Short of a length, to mid-off, and it races away and beats the man
I know you need to bowl short to Gayle but not at Awana's place. Another pull. He has protection, though
short, on the pads, gentle pace, clipped away
short, no sting in it, and has been short-armed away for four
short of a length, on the pads, pushed to leg
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep point for one
short of a length, on off, punched to cover
another inswinger, starts outside leg, headed towards off, and is defended solidly
down the wicket to push this wide of mid-on
inswinger. Hit that, Gayle. Big inswinger, starts outside leg, squares him up, and beats him
follows this outswinger too, gets a single to third man
fuller outswinger, defended with an open face
short of a length, swinging away, Pujara follows it, and is beaten

that's a hundred. It was in Miller's arc. And it is out of the park. They are all swarming Miller. That's length, into the pads, and has been smashed over the sight screen for the match-winning six. That's Miller's Crossing of the line
slow through the air, he has blocked it for one
Four more. What a turnaround. Tossed up outside off, slogged past midwicket. Miller's hundred going away?
full toss. This could finish in this over. Driven over midwicket for four
full and wide, beats his dab
tossed up outside off, Sathish says I will have some of the cake too. Lofted flat over long-on for six
darted wide down the leg side
Vinay recovers well with a yorker outside off. Dug out for one
now Vinay has crumbled under pressure. Bowl the full and fast one, but he has overstepped. Sorry, it is Nigel Llong who has crumbled. Vinay was fine. Unfairly no-balled
that's a parallel six. Short again, but again without much behind it. Miller stands tall and sends it over deep midwicket. Hundred for the partnership. Sathish has scored only 11
AB misfields. The pressure is telling. Pulled to deep midwicket, and AB converts this into two
short, into the body, but no sting in it. Miller backs away, upper-cuts the pants off this ball. Nearly a six
wide length ball, driven on the up to sweeper-cover. Miller is back on strike
short of a length, outside off, he moves across to place this to the right of deep square leg for two
and there is the touch. Deftness. Slower ball, short of a length, on off, he waits for it, then opens the face late to guide it fine of short third man
slightly short of that driving length, he gets it across, wide of deep midwicket, for two
full, outside off, driven wide of deep cover for two
short of a length. Into the pads. Goes for a leg-bye
short of a length, gets an inside edge into the toe for a single
slower ball, on a length, on the pads, Miller has picked this early, waits for it, and sends it way way back over midwicket. You have to bowl short and quick to him
finally bowls a low full toss. Attempted yorker. Dug out for one. Miller has the strike again. Who fancies a bowl?
short, wide, and would have been called a wide had MIller not reached across on a ladder and cut it over point for four
RP continues bowling length at a gentle pace. Miller loves it. Swipes this to midwicket for four. Game is on
length ball, on off, Killer Miller has opened the front hip again, and has nearly killed the non-striker with this missile. Sathish escapes, and Kings Xi get four
back-foot drive for six. What a shot. "Killer Miller," says a placard. Short of a length, outside off, he opens the front leg again, and drives it flat over long-off
bowls it full and wide outside off. Too wide
half-volley. That you cannot bowl to Miller. He clears the front leg, and goes inside-out over long-off. The ball has been lost in the crowd. Punjab Police retrieves it

Can you believe this? Kohli has dropped a skier? And he is hit on the face too. Miller has picked the best ground to hit those skiers in the night. Low floodlights in Mohali, remember? Slogs again, gets a massive top edge, but it bursts through Kohli's hands at extra cover
bowls it short, the ball angles into the body, Miller pulls. Not the best of connections, but he has placed this to the left of deep midwicket
that's a lovely shot. This is in his zone. On a length and on the pads. He makes room, gets under it, and sends it sailing over long-on
short, but this stays low and slow, and hits the bottom half of the bat on the pull, and goes past short fine leg
dropped by Gayle. West Indians at point have not been having the best of times of late. Hit high to his left, he got the hand to it, but couldn't hold on. Not an easy chance, but a chance nonetheless
Miller having trouble with the short ball too. Hit in the rib cage as he is early into the pull
full and straight, driven to long-on for one
short, wide, cut away to deep point
beaten on the pull as this one skids through
pushed to long-on
short of a length, beats him on the pull with a skiddy delivery

Miller sends this to the sky and nobody has got under it. It was Rampaul's catch. Well bowled, though. Gets the edge with extra bounce on a length ball. The ball skies towards mid-on region, and Rampaul is the only man who can go for it. He doesn't. Not saying he would have taken the catch, but he was the closest to it
fast, on a length, pushed back to him
cut away, mis-hit, but doesn't carry to deep point
short of a length, dabbed away to short third man
flat again, but not full, and is worked away to deep midwicket for one
full, flat, into the pads, and lofted straight for a flat six
pulled to deep midwicket for one
short, outside leg, finally called a wide
pulled away to deep midwicket
short of a length, middle and leg, whipped away wide of deep midwicket, and they take three. And this third has been made possible because Sathish dives from about 16 yards. What a dive to make it
short of a length, on off, no room. Defended
short of a length, middle and leg, whipped away for one
slower short ball, Miller watches it well and ramps it over short third man
length ball, into the pads, but this time Henriques has fine leg back
quick, short, down the leg side, but not called wides because Sathish is trying a reverse sweep
holes out to long-on. This chase was always stillborn. Hussey is under pressure to score quickly, and he backs away to try to hit this over long-on. Not full enough, he gets too under it, and is gone
charges at him, drives this full toss to long-off
down the wicket to drive this to long-off
short, wide, cut away to the left of deep cover. They take on Rampaul's arm and take the third. If the throw had been slightly closer, he was gone at the non-striker's end
short of a length, on off, punched to deep cover
short of a length, on off, punched to the left of third man
length ball outside off, pushed to cover
short of a length, on the pads, worked away for one
lenght ball, on off, Hussey swings, and is beaten
pulled away to cow corner, Tiwary chases, dives, keeps it from going to the boundary
length ball, into the pads, worked away to deep midwicket
slow through the air, 75ks, Hussey waits and waits before cutting, and finds point
jumps out of the crease to drive this to long-off for one
sweeps right across a straight delivery, misses, and is caught dead plumb
flighted on off, pushed to cover
short of a length, into the pads, punched away wide of long-on for four
flighted, middle and leg, worked into the leg side for two
driven to extra cover and sets off. The throw from AB misses
short of a length, outside off, dabbed to point
pulled away to deep midwicket
full, outside off, driven to deep cover for one
length ball, into the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, on off, pushed to mid-off
nicely played. On a length, outside off, he has pushed this on the up, between mid-off and extra cover. All along the ground
Gurkeerat is struggling against the short ball. Looks to pull, gets a bottom edge onto his body
on a length, angling in, defended to midwicket
stands and watches. This is a half-volley, on the pads, and has been met with a straight bat to send it to the left of mid-on
short of a length, pushed to mid-off for one
yorker, middle and leg, nudged away for one
runs this off the face of the bat, gets a single to third man
steers this to third man for one
short of a length, on off, defended to cover
lovely pull first ball. Head high, but he has smacked it over midwicket
Vinay makes a good comeback. Down the wicket comes Mandeep, short goes Vinay, it seams in to cramp his shot, and takes the bottom edge through to the keeper
even he starts with a leg-side delivery with fine leg up in the circle. Picked away for four again
dabs away at this shortish delivery to place it to the right of third man for two
short of a length, outside off, defended off the front foot. Not out on nought off six
short again, down the leg side this time
Gurkeerat is doing nothing with these short balls. And RCB are digging it in for him. Defended off the back foot again
full, on off, pushed to mid-off
short of a length, into the pads, worked away for one
poor delivery. Full, down the leg side, with short fine leg up. Flicked away
another good short ball. Rising towards the chest again, and he fends with the bottom off
short of a length, rising towards the chest. Defended with the bottom hand off
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
the big wicket. Te frustrated Marsh drives uppishly at a length ball, and finds extra cover perfectly
length ball, middle and off, driven on the up, but can't beat extra cover
full, tailing in, runs off the inside half of the bat for one
short, sitting up for the pull, and Marsh obliges by despatching it
swinging from short of a length, clipped away for one
wide length ball, angling away, beats his drive
short of a length, angling in, pushed to leg for one
driven on the up, straight to mid-off
full, swinging in to him, hits the pad
short of a length, seaming into the pads, worked away for one
backs away to a length ball, drops it into the off side for one
pulled from outside off, to mid-on
short of a length, moving away a little, punched away to point
short of a length, outside off, pushed to cover
dug in short, into the pads, he has flick-pulled this with the front leg in the air. Through square leg for four. Was bowled at 141ks
